description: A surface for grouping related content with an optional header, body and footer.
whenToUse: Grouping a form into distinct sections
Presenting a summary with title, description and actions
Dashboard tiles that contain a chart or metric
whenNotToUse: Wrapping a plain list that should flow without visual separation (use a list or Separator)
Navigation items (use nav links or sidebar components)
Full-page containers — Card adds a background and border; use a plain div for layout
a11y: Use a semantic heading (h2, h3) inside CardTitle when the card introduces a distinct section — screen readers rely on heading hierarchy for navigation.

Interactive cards (clickable as a whole) need a focusable element such as a Button or Link inside them; wrapping the entire card in an anchor tag is acceptable only when every part of the card is part of that link's label.
